capture_query: where=OpenDate >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-18 00:00:00' | outFields=* | returnGeometry=true | outSR=4326 | orderByFields=SpokanePermitID ASC
layer_selection: MapServer layer 0 'Permit' is the ONLY permit layer; layers 1-3 are PDA Boundaries / City Council Districts / Neighborhood Councils (boundary overlays, no tables). Effectively a single-layer feed — unlike Renton's ~50-sublayer thematic MapServer, which stays backlogged.

manual_comparison.note: 100% point-geometry and parcel coverage. The layer publishes NO contractor/applicant, NO valuation and NO units, and NO issued-date column — so organizations[] is empty, valuationUsd/units are null (never 0) and issueDate is null even for status 'Issued'. The stage carries the issuance fact; a date is never fabricated. 'In Progress' is the Accela application-workflow state (the feed carries a distinct 'Issued'), so it maps to permit_applied — the safer earlier reading.

field_map.externalRef: AccelaPermitID1 (evidence + rawFields only, never a party key)

person_vs_business: No party columns are emitted. PermitManager / PlannerAssigned / PlannerEmail identify CITY STAFF (public employees), not project parties — they are deliberately left unmapped so staff names and emails never enter organizations[] or evidence.
distance_note: Spokane is eastern WA (~300 mi from Solis's Olympia base) — Solis's geography distance band scores it 0.15 (SOLIS_GEOGRAPHY_BANDS, scoring v1.10.0). Onboarded as clean regional corpus data and for future eastern accounts, not as a Solis market.
robots_terms: Public ArcGIS REST MapServer under my.spokanecity.org open data. No auth, no robots restriction on the REST endpoint. Rate: bounded windowed pulls, SOURCE_USER_AGENT.
